testcase.name: Scenario: Keep staged command order when clicking the target Name header: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:630:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Keep staged command order when clicking the target Name header ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog has an initially empty Part Tools custom panel ✔ And the user has staged "3D Annotations" followed by "2D Sketches" ✔ When the user clicks the custom panel list Name header twice ✔ Then the custom panel list remains in this order: | 3D Annotations | | 2D Sketches | ✔ And the target indicates a pending change ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no User Commands panel is displayed on the Tools ribbon
